ideas.title: Deep Dive into Minnesota Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the systemic failures in fraud schemes in Minnesota, focusing on the entities involved, the amounts suspected, and the implications for financial oversight.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the extent of fraud and potential corruption in Minnesota.
questions: What are the key entities involved?
What are the implications for Minnesota's financial oversight?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal significant corruption and systemic failures in financial oversight in Minnesota, potentially leading to high-profile investigations and reforms.

ideas.title: Impact of Hudson River Tunnel Funding Freeze
ideas.description: Explore the implications of the $16B funding freeze for the Hudson River tunnels on infrastructure development and federal funding allocation.
ideas.angle: Analyze the political and developmental impacts of the funding freeze and the lawsuits filed by New York and New Jersey.
questions: What are the immediate impacts on infrastructure development?
How will this affect federal funding allocation?
What are the long-term implications for New York and New Jersey?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the complex interplay between political decisions, infrastructure development, and federal funding, potentially revealing deeper issues in how large-scale projects are funded and managed.
